name: jz_1x1_life_based_phasing
temporal_gate_note: P0 is a site-wide verification gate without a separate polygon; spatial envelopes do not map one-to-one to the P0-P3 timetable in proposal.md

properties.name_zh: 一期：大钟寺—原点公共接口试点
properties.dependency: official boundary, ownership, utilities and safety review required
properties.area_semantics: priority_action_envelope; overlaps phase_2 where implementation interfaces coincide

delivery_register.candidate_asset_owner: existing public-ground or park asset holder (to be named after title check)
delivery_register.candidate_operator: district public-space or park operations team (conceptual role)
delivery_register.independent_reviewer: accessibility + public-service reviewer independent of prototype supplier
delivery_register.funding_type: conceptual public-benefit maintenance/renewal budget; no funding commitment
delivery_register.permit_gate: official boundary, title, rail/river interfaces, fire and accessibility review
delivery_register.stop_signal: ordinary service route unavailable, safety/privacy/accessibility threshold exceeded, or complaint not acknowledged
delivery_register.maintenance_owner: named daily steward plus a separate maintenance lead (both pending confirmation)
delivery_register.minimum_spatial_parameters: continuous accessible bypass; service room and porch dimensions to be field measured
delivery_register.capacity_basis: capacity and staffing to be set from observed service demand, not assumed from polygon area

properties.name_zh: 二期：两翼微循环与近校转化
properties.dependency: official boundary, ownership, utilities and safety review required
properties.area_semantics: priority_action_envelope; overlaps phase_1 and phase_3 where implementation interfaces coincide

delivery_register.candidate_asset_owner: existing education, innovation or community asset holder (to be named after title check)
delivery_register.candidate_operator: community service-room operator with school/enterprise liaison (conceptual role)
delivery_register.independent_reviewer: privacy, IP and care-service reviewer independent of the operator
delivery_register.funding_type: conceptual shared-service and small-repair grant; no funding commitment
delivery_register.permit_gate: official boundary, title, campus edge, fire, safeguarding, night access and utility review
delivery_register.stop_signal: loss of offline equivalent, unapproved data/rights use, unsafe crowding, or unresolved access complaint
delivery_register.maintenance_owner: service-room steward plus facilities technician; named people and rota pending confirmation
delivery_register.minimum_spatial_parameters: step-free counter, quiet/care corner, paper route and clear egress; dimensions to be surveyed
delivery_register.capacity_basis: staffed seats, queue and class capacity to be set after a two-week manual baseline

properties.name_zh: 三期：众智园安全验证与国际传播
properties.dependency: official boundary, ownership, utilities and safety review required
properties.area_semantics: priority_action_envelope; overlaps phase_2 where implementation interfaces coincide

delivery_register.candidate_asset_owner: station-front/commercial or park-interface asset holder (to be named after title check)
delivery_register.candidate_operator: station and public-realm interface operator with repair desk (conceptual role)
delivery_register.independent_reviewer: mobility, heritage and public-safety reviewer independent of terminal supplier
delivery_register.funding_type: conceptual reversible-public-realm pilot allocation; no capital or procurement commitment
delivery_register.permit_gate: official boundary, station/rail interface, pedestrian safety, heritage, fire, utilities and traffic review
delivery_register.stop_signal: conflict at station frontage, blocked accessible route, heritage rights complaint, or manual service capacity below baseline
delivery_register.maintenance_owner: frontage steward plus repair/reuse lead; supplier exit handover required
delivery_register.minimum_spatial_parameters: step-free interchange, unobstructed service edge, staffed repair point and removable fixing grid
delivery_register.capacity_basis: arrival, queue, maintenance and event capacity to be observed before any permanent work
